question: Should maintainers merge this CI-invoked gateway-watch guard change with the current contributor terminal proof, or require a reviewer-controlled guard rerun first?
rationale: The patch is narrow and reviewable, but it changes release/CI diagnostic behavior where green unit tests do not fully settle false-pass or false-fail risk.

options.title: Proceed with current proof

options.title: Request reviewer-controlled rerun
options.body: Ask a maintainer or Testbox lane to rerun the full gateway-watch guard before merge for extra automation confidence.
